description: Shipping and Pilotage (DOT-006) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport. The Shipping and Pilotage Act 1967 (WA) governs shipping and pilotage in and about ports, boat harbours and mooring control areas of the State. A total of 9 ports and 13 commercial port facilities have been declared under the Act. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport. Its tags are jurisdiction, legislation, marine, maritime, navigation. It offers 2 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
